description: This file defines the RequestException class in the GuzzleHttp library, representing exceptions related to HTTP requests, including methods for creating, wrapping, and retrieving related request and response information.

classes.name: RequestException
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request exception, providing methods to access the request, response, and context, and factory methods to create or wrap exceptions.

methods.name: wrapException
methods.description: Wraps a general Throwable into a RequestException if it isn't one already.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new RequestException with a detailed error message based on the request and response.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the HTTP request that caused the exception.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the associated response, if any.

methods.name: hasResponse
methods.description: Indicates whether a response was received.

methods.name: getHandlerContext
methods.description: Provides contextual information from the handler about the error.
